note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes LicenseAssignment.Read.All, User.Read.All, SensitivityLabel.Read, Sites.Read.All, Files.Read.All, Files.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Sites.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $dir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep08'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null; $f = Join-Path $dir 'Contoso travel policy.docx'; Remove-Item $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $z = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($f, 'Create'); $add = { param($n, $t) $e = $z.CreateEntry($n); $w = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($e.Open()); $w.Write($t); $w.Dispose() }; & $add '[Content_Types].xml' '<?xml version="1.0"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/></Types>'; & $add '_rels/.rels' '<?xml version="1.0"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/></Relationships>'; & $add 'word/document.xml' '<?xml version="1.0"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>Contoso travel policy (fictional lab file). Book economy for trips under six hours. Hotel up to 150 per night. Submit expenses within 30 days. Trips over 5000 need director approval.</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:body></w:document>'; $z.Dispose()
# lab site MG Lab - Marketing (group-connected team site, labadmin owner) with fictional files and one organization link

$g = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Marketing'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $g) { $g = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = 'MG Lab - Marketing'; mailNickname = 'mglab-marketing'; mailEnabled = $true; securityEnabled = $false; groupTypes = @('Unified'); 'owners@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/me).id)") } }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30 -and -not $drive; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; try { $drive = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)/sites/root/drive" } catch {} }

foreach ($path in 'Campaigns/Launch plan.docx', 'HR/Payroll 2026.xlsx', 'HR/salary-bands.xlsx', 'Board/minutes.docx') { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method PUT -Uri "/v1.0/drives/$($drive.id)/root:/$($path):/content" -ContentType 'text/plain' -Body 'Contoso lab file' | Out-Null }; $lp = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/drives/$($drive.id)/root:/Campaigns/Launch plan.docx"; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/drives/$($drive.id)/items/$($lp.id)/createLink" -Body @{ type = 'view'; scope = 'organization' } | Out-Null

# the 'Everyone except external users' grant on HR and an Anyone link are NOT scripted (people picker not verified; do not change the tenant sharing policy). Check the dry run for the EveryoneExceptExternalUsers row.

screens.name: licences
steps: Billing > Licenses: the E5 trial and the Copilot Studio trial are listed, no Microsoft 365 Copilot
Then run the readiness check in the terminal (see also[]): 'Copilot licence in tenant: NO' and the user table with the real statuses

screens.name: chat
steps: Show the Work label under the profile and the green data protection shield
Attach 'Contoso travel policy.docx' (created in %TEMP%\mglab-ep08 by prepare)
Ask: 'Summarise this document in three bullet points'
Capture the real answer. Do not ask about 'my emails' or company files: without the add-on Chat is not grounded in Microsoft Graph, show only what really happens
Optional: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings, capture only
mask: Alex e-mail beyond the lab alias

steps: SharePoint: open the 'MG Lab - Marketing' site > Documents > Campaigns
'Launch plan.docx' > Manage access: the organization link shown by the script
Purview portal > Information protection > Sensitivity labels: the labels from episode 5 (Public, General, Confidential)
If the label call was refused (403), show the error and fix the consent: do not fall back to a snapshot

teardown: foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Marketing'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)" }   # the team site goes with its group
# by hand: delete the uploaded 'Contoso travel policy.docx' conversation in Copilot Chat if it holds more than the demo
needs: trial:Microsoft 365 E5 (Copilot Chat for Entra accounts)
episode-5 sensitivity labels (or record the NoLabels finding honestly)
blocked: Nothing blocks the four screens. The optional "NEEDS COPILOT LICENCE" insert (Copilot in Word, usage report, SharePoint Advanced Management) is not defined: no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence is bought (about 216 to 360 USD a year for one seat; owner decides).
